title: platform.gdpr.cascade_completed.v1
description: A service finished its part of a user's GDPR deletion (ADR-005). yc-audit marks the service complete in the cascade register. Published under the deleted user's tenant.

action.description: What the service did with the user's records: removed them, stripped the personal data, or replaced user_id with the pseudonym.

record_count.description: Records changed or removed; 0 when the service held nothing for the user.
